text:
maria: Morning async — quick sync on gateway/auth/rate limits (what I did / blockers / today)
maria: What I did: ran auth rotation scenario in staging; noticed a brief 401 spike (~1.2%) lasting ~3m around 10:12UTC.
maria: Blocker: cannot reproduce locally with same tokens — seems tied to JWK cache refresh timing in ingress filter. Need someone to validate refresh logic.
maria: Today: add JWK refresh telemetry + run a short canary while we iterate.
ajay: I dug into logs — same 401 pattern. sample log: `WARN jwt: no matching kid (kid=abcd1234) src=gw-staging-3 2026-03-18T10:12:07Z`
ajay: I pushed a tiny change to auth-filter to make JWK cache TTL 60s (was 300s) -> PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/432 (please review). Pinging @zach for perf/regression check.
zach: Will review after my morning tests finish. Quick note: changing `global.rate_limiter.burst_multiplier` interacts with batching paths; let's avoid parallel BURST changes until auth PR lands. :eyes: 
lina: FYI flipped on a prom alert for `jwt_mismatch_rate > 0.5%` in staging and captured the spike graph: https://grafana.redwood/staging/d/abcd/jwt-metrics (snapshot).
sam_k: Yesterday: merged the gw route-policy for /v2/cache which knocked down a class of 500s. Today: running a 1h canary for that route, watching 429 counts. Blocker: integration tests need a small quota bump on staging — filing infra ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started — cluster=gw-staging-3 image=infra/gw:2026.03.18-canary-1 (canary id=canary-789)
maria: I added a tiny reproduction script in staging (curl against public ingress):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <stale-token>" \ 
  -H "kid: abcd1234" \ 
  https://gw-staging.redwood/api/v1/health
```
ajay: dev tip: to reproduce locally run `make dev-gateway` + `curl -H 'kid: abcd1234'` — happy to pair for 15m if anyone's free.
zach: PR #432 LGTM aside from a doc nit on the TTL constant name (left a comment on line 42). If CI passes I'll merge and coordinate canary.
lina: Also observed that a recent loadtest produced bursty behavior that drove 429s. Switching the limiter to a leaky-bucket smoothing cut immediate 429s. Proposal: default `burst_multiplier=1.5` for staging, keep production at 1.0 until we validate.
sam_k: Opening infra ticket for quota bump + staging config tear-down: infra#789 (link: https://issues.redwood/infra/789)
maria: Thanks all — owners: @ajay @zach on auth, @lina @sam_k on rate limits. I'll close loop once telemetry shows JWK refresh caught the mismatches. :thumbsup:
